items.title: George Justin Interview, 1958-06-01
items.q: I used to hear some of the fellas talk about him... Earl Hines had made an appearance in New Orleans there... he said, well I'd never heard a fella like this play before.

ctx.x: Was that up on Liberty Street about?

That's right. That was on Liberty Street because at that time I was staying on Liberty Street right across from the- Oh. From the- The Walk Raiders Hall. 925 North Liberty Street. Nice. Of course that number was 929, right next door. And there was always confusion about getting on the piano. You know who our kids are. They want to beat the brother to the piano. And of course Burnell I used to think he had exceptionally good talent. And I used to hear some of the fellas talk about him, what a wonderful left hand…
